sources.title: Data Products
supports: API and customizable CSV or Avro data-package access
The Candidacies Dataset advertises campaign websites, social links, and win/loss results since 2018 for most US positions
Pricing is obtained through the provider rather than shown on the page

sources.title: Request a data demo
supports: The form is presented as a route to a free data sample and pricing information

sources.title: BallotReady Data Tiers
supports: Default Tier 3 coverage includes municipal candidates in cities above 50,000 population
Smaller municipal coverage is an add-on

providers.public_price_status: No price schedule found; campaign contact information is described as an add-on available for an additional charge.

sources.title: Data dictionary: Candidates
supports: Candidate rows contain election date, stage, candidate, office, district, and race identifiers
campaign_website is a campaign contact field available as an additional-charge add-on

sources.title: About the Candidates data set
supports: Each row represents candidate participation in a stage, or candidate-stage-round for ranked-choice voting
Race, stage, and candidate identifiers distinguish event participation

sources.title: Election dates
supports: The parameterized election-date list returns data from 2018 onward

sources.title: Elections by state
supports: Past election dates may be queried and return candidates who were on the ballot
Local executive offices and stage or ranked-choice fields can be represented

sources.title: Terms of Use
supports: Licensed data sets are proprietary and confidential
Full data sets may not be shared with third parties
Internal or external product use must prevent third-party bulk download

sources.title: Downloading bulk data via the client portal
supports: Licensed bulk data can be delivered in CSV or JSON through a client portal or API

sources.title: Elections API
supports: The product page reports more than 14,000 federal, state, and local elections published since 2020
The product covers municipal elections and uses both official sources and third-party tools including Ballotpedia
Pricing is request-based

sources.title: Democracy Works API 2.0 documentation
supports: Authentication requires an API key and the page directs users to contact the provider for pricing and a test key
Candidate records include campaign website contact fields
Documented local candidate coverage includes mayors and city councils in the top 100 cities, subject to mapping limits
The documentation describes the API as serving upcoming elections, so historical access is not established by the public endpoint description
